walkthroughs.body_html:
Component 1: Personal Portfolio — a core area of GCSE Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Component 1: Personal Portfolio brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Component 1: Personal Portfolio.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

Squares
An Italian school of artists.

Visual equilibrium achieved with different elements of equal visual weight on each side.

mcqs.q: Why is preserving white in watercolour important?
options: Because white is the most expensive colour.
You can simply paint white over other colours later.
A composition with no balance.
White comes from the paper showing through - there is no true white pigment in traditional watercolour.
